name: How long does a noise-reducing sliding door replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a noise-reducing sliding door replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard noise-reducing sliding door replacement projects can be completed within one to two days, from removal to final trim. This timeline can vary depending on the complexity of the existing opening, any necessary structural modifications, or if multiple doors are being replaced. Custom orders for doors can also extend the overall project duration due to manufacturing lead times. We strive to minimize disruption to your home during the installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard projects typically take one to two days. Factors like opening complexity or custom orders can extend the timeline.
